items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you said “Joe, I‘m playing a little sharp and it’s bothering me”, and Joe replied: “Well, in Paris, A is up to four forty-two...”

ctx.x: Just in general I wanted to find out . . .
. . . and you said “Joe, I‘m playing a little sharp and it’s bothering me”, and Joe replied: “Well, in Paris, A is up to four forty-two, so maybe you’re just ahead of your time.”
Yeah, oh yeah, okay. I do remember that, I appreciated that very much. The only thing is when I’m in Paris I play at four forty three, at least. [Laughs]
